Original self-generated fixtures for RustView, available under the project MIT license. No third-party photographs or image data.
All canvases are 4x2 RGBA, with three frames at 30ms, 50ms, and 0ms. Runtime clamps the final delay to 10ms.
GIF frames are encoded with gif 0.14.2. First frame is red; second is blue plus transparent pixels in the left 2x2; third is green in the right 2x2.
animation-previous.gif uses Previous disposal on frame two and Netscape repeat=1 (two total plays). animation-background.gif uses Background disposal and infinite repeat.
animation-blend.webp uses image 0.25.9 lossless VP8L frame payloads in a standards-compliant RIFF/VP8X/ANIM/ANMF container assembled only by this test-data generator. Runtime decoding/compositing is provided by image/image-webp.
WebP frame one is red. Frame two blends 50-percent-alpha blue in the left 2x2 and disposes that rectangle to the transparent ANIM background. Frame three replaces the right 2x2 with green. ANIM loop_count=2 means two total plays.
